name: KeaCam — Chennai weather-station webcams
description: KeaWeather publishes three outdoor views (West, South-East and North-East). Its About Us page says still images upload every 3–5 minutes. This entry opens the publisher's page only; the app does not copy, embed, proxy or record the images.
